title: Leviticus 24: The Pure Oil, the Shewbread, and the Blasphemer
body:
Read the chapter → [Leviticus 24](/bible/leviticus/24)

**[Leviticus 24:1-4](/bible/leviticus/24#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/leviticus/24#v1)</sup> And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
>
> <sup>[2](/bible/leviticus/24#v2)</sup> Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/leviticus/24#v3)</sup> Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the Lord continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.
>
> <sup>[4](/bible/leviticus/24#v4)</sup> He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the Lord continually.

- The children of Israel were commanded to bring pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually. Aaron ordered it from the evening unto the morning before the Lord continually, upon the pure candlestick, a statute for ever in your generations.

  Precepts:
  - **[Exodus 31:8](/bible/exodus/31#v8)**
    > <sup>[8](/bible/exodus/31#v8)</sup> And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,

    The pure candlestick with all his furniture was part of the tabernacle work; the lamps ordered on it burned before the Lord continually.

**[Leviticus 24:5-9](/bible/leviticus/24#v5)**

> <sup>[5](/bible/leviticus/24#v5)</sup> And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.
>
> <sup>[6](/bible/leviticus/24#v6)</sup> And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the Lord.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/leviticus/24#v7)</sup> And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
>
> <sup>[8](/bible/leviticus/24#v8)</sup> Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the Lord continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/leviticus/24#v9)</sup> And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the Lord made by fire by a perpetual statute.

- Twelve cakes of fine flour were set in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the Lord, with pure frankincense upon each row, every sabbath, taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
- It shall be Aaron's and his sons', and they shall eat it in the holy place, for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the Lord made by fire.

**[Leviticus 24:10-16](/bible/leviticus/24#v10)**

> <sup>[10](/bible/leviticus/24#v10)</sup> And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;
>
> <sup>[11](/bible/leviticus/24#v11)</sup> And the Israelitish woman’s son blasphemed the name of the Lord, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/leviticus/24#v12)</sup> And they put him in ward, that the mind of the Lord might be shewed them.
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/leviticus/24#v13)</sup> And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
>
> <sup>[14](/bible/leviticus/24#v14)</sup> Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
>
> <sup>[15](/bible/leviticus/24#v15)</sup> And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
>
> <sup>[16](/bible/leviticus/24#v16)</sup> And he that blasphemeth the name of the Lord, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the Lord, shall be put to death.

- The son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel, and strove in the camp with a man of Israel, and blasphemed the name of the Lord, and cursed. His mother was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
- They put him in ward, that the mind of the Lord might be shewed them; and the Lord commanded that he that had cursed be brought forth without the camp, that all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and that all the congregation stone him. The strife in the camp likely arose from a man of Israel correcting him concerning the law.
- His father being an Egyptian shows he was conceived while Israel was in captivity in the land of Egypt, dwelling among the Egyptians; in the same way Moses, outside of Egypt with Jethro the priest of Midian, took a wife there. And there is no such thing as being half Israelite or a fourth Israelite: if your parent is Israel, you are Israel.
- Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin, and he that blasphemeth the name of the Lord, he shall surely be put to death, as well the stranger as he that is born in the land.

**[Leviticus 24:17-23](/bible/leviticus/24#v17)**

> <sup>[17](/bible/leviticus/24#v17)</sup> And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/leviticus/24#v18)</sup> And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
>
> <sup>[19](/bible/leviticus/24#v19)</sup> And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;
>
> <sup>[20](/bible/leviticus/24#v20)</sup> Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.
>
> <sup>[21](/bible/leviticus/24#v21)</sup> And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.
>
> <sup>[22](/bible/leviticus/24#v22)</sup> Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the Lord your God.
>
> <sup>[23](/bible/leviticus/24#v23)</sup> And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the Lord commanded Moses.

- He that killeth any man shall surely be put to death, and he that killeth a beast shall make it good, beast for beast. If a man cause a blemish in his neighbour, as he hath done, so shall it be done to him: breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. One manner of law stood for the stranger as for one of your own country.
- When Christ came he taught the proper understanding of eye for eye for dealing inside the nation: ye have heard that it hath been said, an eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth, but I say unto you that ye resist not evil. As the Son of God he had authority to magnify the law: whosoever smites thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also; if any man sue thee and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also; whosoever compels thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
- Inside our nation we must practice forgiveness, patience, and long-suffering; we are dealing with our own people, brothers with a conscience. We are the most forgiving people on the planet; the only time we do not know how to forgive is when it comes to each other, and Christ dealt with that.

  Precepts:
  - **[Matthew 5:38-42](/bible/matthew/5#v38)**
    > <sup>[38](/bible/matthew/5#v38)</sup> Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
    >
    > <sup>[39](/bible/matthew/5#v39)</sup> But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
    >
    > <sup>[40](/bible/matthew/5#v40)</sup> And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloke also.
    >
    > <sup>[41](/bible/matthew/5#v41)</sup> And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
    >
    > <sup>[42](/bible/matthew/5#v42)</sup> Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.

    Ye have heard that it hath been said, an eye for an eye; but I say unto you that ye resist not evil; Christ magnified the law for how brothers deal with brothers.
